rationale: This is a monotone rank transform of an already-archived signal that by the proposer's own admission leaves the portfolio sort, alpha and Sharpe literally unchanged, so it is a cosmetic re-specification of the Fama-MacBeth regressor rather than a new economic hypothesis.

The net-of-cash denominator with a maturing-debt floor is a genuinely economics-driven change to the binding solvency quantity rather than a rescaling, though the MAX floor makes the denominator discontinuous across the cash-rich/cash-poor boundary and may create a mixed-regime signal whose interpretation is harder than the reasoning suggests.

target_name: Economic Net Worth per Dollar of Obligations
rationale: The construction is dimensionally coherent and the additive-in-dollars restatement of equity is a defensible single quantity, but retained-earnings-to-liabilities is the dominant term and is itself a well-known Altman/distress component, so the test needs to show the R&D and goodwill adjustments add anything beyond a repackaged RE-based distress screen.

Differencing this ratio mechanically converts it into a mixture of R&D-stock growth, liability growth and goodwill changes, so the signal is largely a rediscovery of the debt-issuance/asset-growth and acquisition-underperformance anomalies and overlaps archived goodwill-change and debt-change signals rather than testing the stated repricing-on-news mechanism.

This is the same two ingredients as the archived "Acquired Equity Without Earned Profits" re-expressed as a continuous difference, and the retained-earnings-to-assets leg is itself a documented distress/quality anomaly with exactly the hypothesized sign, so it is simultaneously a within-archive variant and a partial rediscovery.

target_name: Knowledge Capital per Dollar of Obligations
rationale: An ablation of one leg has some diagnostic value, but as a standalone signal R&D stock scaled by liabilities is close to the published R&D-intensity/leverage anomalies and adds no new mechanism beyond what several archived xrd-scaled signals already test.
